attributes.probed_form:
RAW BASELINE real 42, insns T174/O174, opcode multiset DIFFERS: target-only +3 addi, ours-only -3 mr. Aligned entry block: target homes the three f32* params with `addi r25,r4,0` / `addi r26,r5,0` / `addi r27,r6,0` while using `mr r24,r3` for `Critter *c`; ours emits `mr` for all four. Plus a clean 3-cycle FPR recolor (target f26/f27/f28 <-> ours f28/f26/f27) and an entry-block reordering.
A1 array-declared vector params -- `f32 origin[3], f32 forward[3], f32 out[3]` in BOTH the forward declaration (critter.c L680) and the definition (L2807) -> NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL, object bytes unchanged. REFUTES the natural hypothesis that the addi form is array decay: MWCC decays array params in the front end, so the declared form is invisible to codegen.
A2 declaration order -- `f64 eps2;` moved from last to first in the local block -> REGRESSED real 42->62.
A3 K&R-style parameter declarations for the definition, with the forward declaration weakened to `f32 CritterLineRootColSub();` so the K&R definition would compile (an ANSI prototype + K&R definition is a hard MWCC error, measured first) -> REGRESSED real 42->112 and, decisively, INTRODUCED TWO `frsp` INSTRUCTIONS the target does not contain (multiset target-only +3 addi +2 fmr, ours-only -2 frsp -3 mr). REFUTATION: the target carries no float->double promotion, therefore the original definition was PROTOTYPED, not K&R. This closes the K&R axis for this function permanently.
A4 `#pragma opt_lifetimes off` / `reset` scoped around the function -> NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL, bytes unchanged.
attributes.residual: UNCLOSED, real 42. Residual = a 3-cycle callee-saved FPR renaming + an entry-block reordering + three copy-form sites where target uses `addi rD,rS,0` and we use `mr rD,rS`. The copy-form half is NOT explained by parameter declaration form (A1) nor by K&R homing (A3, refuted by the absent frsp). A supporting microbenchmark compiled with this TU's exact cflags (see claim.PR_law.mwcc-pointer-param-copy-form...) shows MWCC emits `addi rD,rS,0` for pointer-param copies in ALL five isolated forms tested and never `mr`, and our own critter.o contains 548 `addi rD,rS,0` against 214 `mr` -- so the form is freely available to the compiler and its selection here is an allocator decision inside a high-pressure function, not a source-visible type property. DO-NOT-RETRY: array-form params, eps2-first declaration order, K&R definition, opt_lifetimes.
